description: Aligned xyxy EIoU with IoU, normalized center-distance, width, and height penalties from paper §3.2 Eq. (7); xyxy geometry follows src/topologies/implementations/training/core.py:139-155. Excludes Focal-EIoU weighting.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, analysis, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def train_case(name, size, shift, size_change, batch_size):
    @synth.generator
    def samples(ctx):
        index = int(ctx.index)
        inputs = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
        x1 = 0.1 + (index % 3) * shift
        y1 = 0.15 + (index % 4) * shift
        width = 0.5 + (index % 2) * size_change
        height = 0.6 + (index % 3) * size_change
        targets = torch.tensor([x1, y1, x1 + width, y1 + height]).unsqueeze(0)
        return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(inputs), "targets": synth.Tensor(targets)}
    dataset = synth.Spec(name, generator=samples, size=size, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
    train = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
    val = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="val", like=train)
    class BoxPredictor(nn.Module):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__()
            self.network = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=4)
        def forward(self, inputs):
            raw = self.network(inputs)
            lower = raw[..., :2].sigmoid()
            upper = lower + torch.nn.functional.softplus(raw[..., 2:]) + 0.01
            return {"boxes": torch.cat((lower, upper), dim=-1).unsqueeze(-2)}
    model = BoxPredictor()
    trainer = Trainer(model, train, val, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "eiou", "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "boxes"}, "targets": {"batch": "targets"}}}, batch_size=batch_size, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
    trainer.fit()
    metrics = trainer.evaluate(val)
    assert all(torch.isfinite(torch.tensor(value)) for value in metrics.values())
    return analysis.analyze(model)
tiny_report = train_case("eiou-tiny-boxes", 4, 0.0, 0.0, 1)
small_report = train_case("eiou-small-boxes", 12, 0.02, 0.05, 4)

name: Efficient IoU loss

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported; unrecognized keyword parameters raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because aligned box pairs do not use ignored indices
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point aligned xyxy boxes shaped [...,4] with at least one leading box dimension and strictly positive width and height
parameters.reduction: none returns one loss per box pair, mean averages pairs, or sum totals pairs (default mean)
parameters.targets: finite floating-point xyxy boxes matching prediction shape, dtype, and device, with strictly positive width and height
